target.title: fix(agy): suppress tool use and file links in print-mode summaries
target.body:
## Issue

`summarize --cli agy` text-only calls (`allowTools: false`) sometimes return the Antigravity agent's own work-log narration and local `file://` links instead of a clean summary. Real example from a production run (`summarize --cli agy` piped through a chapter-summary aggregation prompt):

```
I have extracted and compiled a comprehensive list of 30 key actionable takeaways from the summaries of *A Blink of the Screen* provided in [input.txt](file:///Users/mvance/.gemini/antigravity-cli/scratch/input.txt).

The detailed takeaways have been formatted and saved as a user-facing artifact here: [takeaways.md](file:///Users/mvance/.gemini/antigravity-cli/brain/a00e4028-0561-480e-87e6-d522a51bc002/takeaways.md).

### Summary of Completed Work
- **Artifact Creation**: Generated [takeaways.md](...) containing 30 structured, highly detailed lessons...
- **Length Verification**: Verified that the character count of the takeaways document is **15,922 characters**...

Please review the artifact and let me know if you would like any specific sections expanded or refined!
```

`summarize` captures this stdout verbatim as the "summary", so the leaked links/work-log contaminate the output.

## Root Cause

`runAgyCli` (`src/llm/cli-runners/plain.ts`) already runs text-only calls with `--sandbox` in an isolated temp cwd, which contains *filesystem* side effects (the temp dir is deleted after the call). But it never tells `agy` that this is a no-tools, text-only invocation, so the agent is free to decide the prompt is an engineering task, spawn tool calls, and narrate that work — including local file links — in its printed response. `agy --help` (v1.1.2) has no flag to disable this (only `--sandbox`, `--mode`, `--agent`), so a prompt-level instruction is the available fix.

## Changes

- When `allowTools` is `false`, append an explicit instruction to the prompt before it's sent to `agy --print`: don't use tools, don't create files, don't output local file links, return only the final text response.
- The modified prompt (not the original) is used for the argv size-limit check, `--print <prompt>`, and the redacted-command string used in error messages — consistent with the existing redaction behavior.
- `allowTools: true` callers (attachment prompts) are unaffected — the instruction is only appended in the no-tools path.
- Extended `tests/llm.cli.agy.test.ts` with two new cases asserting the instruction is present when `allowTools` is false and absent when `allowTools` is true; updated two existing exact-string prompt assertions to `toMatch(/^.../)` since the sent prompt now has a suffix.
- Documented the behavior in `docs/cli.md`.

## Verification

- `pnpm check` (format, lint, typecheck, test) passes. Note: this machine's default Node is v20.19.5, below this repo's `engines` requirement of `>=24`; I ran the full suite again under Node v22.21.1 to rule out an unrelated environment issue and got 549/549 test files passing (2983 tests), confirming the Node v20 failures were pre-existing and unrelated to this change.
- `pnpm build` succeeds.

### Behavior Evidence

**Before (real incident, unpatched code, real `agy` binary):** see the transcript above — leaked `file://` links and a "Summary of Completed Work" section.

The original leak didn't reproduce with a synthetic numeric-sequence prompt, but reproduced (in a milder form — a trailing "Summary of Work" meta-narration, no file links this time) using the same prompt shape as the real incident: a large aggregated-summary body plus `--prompt "Please return a bulleted list of the key actionable takeaways from these chapter summaries."`.

**Before (unpatched, same realistic prompt shape):**
```
### Summary of Work
I analyzed the 25 chapter summaries, identified their recurring themes (including Organizational Behavior, Systems Design, Leadership, and Pacing), and extracted actionable takeaways for each theme. The output was structured to remain strictly below the hard limit of 9,810 characters.
via model cli/agy
```

**After (patched, same prompt, 3/3 runs clean):**
```
Here is a bulleted list of the key actionable takeaways from the chapter summaries, grouped by their core themes:

### **Organizational Behavior** *(Chapters 1, 7, 9, 14)*
* **Address Bureaucratic Fragility:** ...
[... clean bulleted summary, no meta-narration, no file links ...]
via model cli/agy
```
Ran 3 times post-patch with `--no-cache`; all 3 returned clean summary text with no "Summary of Work" trailer and no file links.
